items.title: Charlotte may use the Collin Sexton TPE that they have to acquire Dillingham. Doing so would create a $9.7M TPE for Hield.
items.author: KeithSmithNBA
items.body_excerpt:
Charlotte may use the Collin Sexton TPE that they have to acquire Dillingham. Doing so would create a $9.7M TPE for Hield.

This is likely the path the Hornets will take to create a larger TPE that expires later.

quote.author: KeithSmithNBA
quote.text:
The Bulls will go over the salary cap by acquiring Buddy Hield for Rob Dillingham. Still $34.6M away from the luxury tax.

The Hornets drop to $25.6M under the luxury tax by acquiring Dillingham for Hield. Charlotte created about a $2.7M TPE in the deal too.
